settings.title: Activate Your Body's Natural Repair Capabilities
settings.content:
Your body is constantly working to repair itself, but as we age, that process can slow down.

LifePharm products help give your body a natural boost. We use fertilized avian eggs, packed with tiny messengers called growth factors that are extracted at their peak activity.

settings.title: How it Works
settings.content:
Our fertilized avian egg extract contains growth factors.  These signal stem cells to areas in the body needing work.

Stem cells can be guided to transform into specific cells to help repair and regenerate tissues in the body that are damaged.

settings.title: Additional Support
settings.content:
Our fertilized avian egg extract also contains other important cellular factors and all 22 essential amino acids.

These are building blocks of protein that are essential for repairing tissues, reducing inflammation, regenerating cells, and synthesizing hormones and neurotransmitters (brain chemicals).

settings.title: Science-Backed Benefits
settings.content:
Studies suggest the combination of growth factors, cellular factors, and amino acids in our fertilized avian egg extract might help:

  • Enhance your body's natural repair capabilities.*
  • Rebuild damaged tissues and cartilage.*
  • Slow down or reverse signs of aging.*

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease.

settings.liquid: Scientific Advisory Board

settings.title: Thomas Staudacher
settings.content:
N.D, LifePharm Scientific Advisory Board Member

Thomas Staudacher has worked in the field of holistic medicine since graduating from the Germany-based Paracelsus School of Naturopathy in 2003. The Australian-based naturopathic doctor founded a relaxation technique called Acoustic Restoration Therapy™ and currently runs both the International Holistic Clinic of Natural Medicine and Subtle Energy Solution. Staudacher received advanced diplomas in naturopathy, nutrition, acupuncture, and homeopathy from the Australian Institute of Applied Science in Brisbane.

settings.title: Kimberly Purdy Lloyd
settings.content:
Executive Research and Development Scientist 

Extensive and ongoing research is an absolute necessity for LifePharm. Kimberly Purdy Lloyd has a career path of formidable experience in dietary supplement and specialty skincare formulations. She joined the Dietary Supplement industry with specialties in Wound Care and Cosmetic Formulations, developing clinical and basic research protocols and peer publishes results.

settings.title: Giuseppe Maffi
settings.content:
Ph.D, N.D, Scientific Advisory Board Member

Dr. Giuseppe Maffi is a biologist and naturopath specializing in mitochondrial health, oxidative stress, and epigenetic therapies. With over 20 years of experience, he has advised leading nutraceutical and biotech companies on product development, scientific strategy, and regulatory affairs. A founding member of the Well Aging Project Society, Dr. Maffi is also a frequent speaker and published expert in the field of anti-aging and redox science.

settings.title: Samina Ahmad
settings.content:
M.D., HHC, ALC, AP & AFNC, LifePharm Scientific Advisory Board Member

While working as an Internal Medicine Physician, Dr. Samina Ahmad championed efforts for underprivileged Pakistani women and children. She is a strong advocate for better healthcare and nutrition in underserved countries. She received her medical degree from the University of Punjab in Pakistan and holds numerous certifications. Currently, she operates Samina’s Wellness in New York.

settings.title: Sewite M. Negash
settings.content:
Ph.D, NIH, Science Advisory Board Member

Dr. Sewite M. Negash got her Ph.D. in Biochemistry & Biophysics from the University of Kansas and did her post-doctoral training at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and at the Pacific Northwest National Labs. She teaches college level biotechnology, chemistry and biochemistry courses, and her primary interest lies in understanding the interplay between chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, and the body’s anti-oxidant protection systems in health and disease. She has been published in numerous peer-reviewed journals. Through her philanthropic work, she advocates for access to free, quality education for all in Africa.

settings.title: Frigyes Back
settings.content:
Science Advisory Board Member

Dr. Frigyes Back is a highly experienced specialist in surgery and proctology with decades of service in traditional medicine. He earned his medical degree from Semmelweis University of Medicine in Budapest in 1975 and completed his surgical specialization in 1980.Dr. Back began his medical career as an assistant lecturer at the Surgical Clinic of the Postgraduate Medical Training Institute. Over the years, he gained valuable international experience in Austria and Germany, and held key positions at esteemed institutions such as the 3rd Surgical Clinic of Semmelweis University and István Hospital. He later served as Chief Medical Inspector at the National Health Insurance Fund.

settings.title: Scientific Advisory Board Member
settings.content:
LifePharm Scientific Advisory Board Member

Mariana M. Lucero, DO, MS is a physician and biomedical scientist dedicated to translating cutting-edge research into practical, results-driven wellness strategies. Dr. Lucero earned her BS in Human Biology from the University of California, San Diego, and her MS in Biomedical Sciences and Doctorate in Osteopathic Medicine from Western University of Health Sciences. She is currently an MBA candidate at Eastern University and completed postgraduate training in General Surgery and in Functional Medicine. Dr. Lucero is passionate about advancing health equity and empowering individuals through evidence-based, regenerative approaches to optimize health.
